data.summary: During your Shooting phase, you may pick one enemy unit 12" or less from this unit, or 18" or less if a Lieutenant in Reiver Armour leads this unit. The picked unit takes a Battle-shock test, with 1 subtracted from the result for a PSYKER unit. On a failed test, that unit is both Battle-shocked and Stunned; Stunned lasts until your next Shooting phase starts. Psychic Attacks made by models in a Stunned unit get -1 to the Hit roll.
